verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robotics simulator. Field robot fleet resilience, meaning operating through cloud outages, buffering data locally and recovering, is a runtime and fleet-ops axis outside a simulator's category. Nothing in the evidence shows Gazebo ships such a capability; Gazebo Transport is socket-based pub/sub messaging for simulation, not offline buffering or reconnect handling.

support.subject: As an ops lead, my robots keep operating and buffer data locally when cloud connectivity drops, then recover cleanly
